g.text: Distribute request/data evenly across the servers during horizontal scaling
Consistent hashing is the technique that is used here
N --> size of the server Pool
Server pool is fixed and data distribution is even
Server goes offline cache most of the cache will be connected to the wrong servers to fetch data,this causes strom of cache misses
When new server get added only K/N Keys need to remapped on Average
Using the same hash function we map server on on the ring based on the Ip Address or Name on the ring
There is still a Chance for the non uniform distribution
Each server is represented by mutiple virtual nodes on the ring
trade of b/w no of nodes and computation
There will cache misses because server-1 is down and all the request are redirected to another server where data is not present in the cache
